'''Trence Vosh''' was an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]] [[Leviathan (Dreadnaught-class)|''Leviathan'']].
